test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I’m sure to succeed at the long run.
solution: The correct answer is** 'at the'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'in the'** should be used instead of **'at the'.** • **'In the long run' **is a phrase of **'long' **that means** "over or after a long period of time; eventually"**. • For Example - It saves money **in the long run.** • Thus, the erroneous part is **'at the'.** **Correct Sentence:__** *I'm sure to succeed **in** the long run.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां **'at the'** की जगह **'in the' **का इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए। • 'In the long run' एक वाक्यांश है जिसका अर्थ है **"लंबे समय तक या बाद में; अंततः"**। • उदाहरण के लिए - It saves money in the long run. • इस प्रकार, गलत हिस्सा **'at the'** है। d7:Tcfc, The erroneous part is **'to go abroad'.**
